Name: Skeleton Critter
Information:
**Skeleton Critter**

A small skeletal beast made from the bones of a small creature like a goblin, dog, kobold, or otherwise. They are used as fodder and as alarm systems.

**Pact of the Chain.** A warlock who takes the Pact of the Chain may choose a skeleton critter as their familiar. When they do, it considers the warlock to be an undead for the purposes of its effects.

Stat Blocks.title: Skeleton Critter
languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can’t speak

traits.name: Undead Tactics
traits.description: The skeleton has advantage on attack rolls against targets when another undead ally is within 5 feet of their target, unless those undead are incapacitated.

actions.name: Rotting Rake
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage plus 3 (1d4) poison damage.

actions.name: Blare
actions.description: The skeleton lets out a screech that alerts all creatures within 150 feet, carrying a distinct tone that other undead and those who create them recognize as a signal corresponding to their situation. They can relay danger, a lack of danger, falling back, victory, defeat, or other simple ideas or circumstances. This sound is only stopped by a solid wall or barricade at least 1-foot thick.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.description: The skeleton takes the Dash or Disengage action.
